clang:

capture_environment_difference: original capture retained test images; native measurements use normal cleanup and no profiler

license.superluminal: proprietary, installed license active; bundled Superluminal_Commandline_LICENSE.md

measurement_limitations: A/A control is the OS module, not the complete suite.
First candidate instruction experiment has complete raw counts but an incomplete tool receipt because of qualified-event parser bug #4123; retained separately.
Nested namespace OS suite has one pre-existing churn-seam assertion failure on both baseline and final candidate; recorded on #2380.
First full-suite driver session exited 143 before summary; 11 completed stdout results retained, but no timing claim from that attempt.
Four bf29aed durable native pairs are superseded by the final regression-fixture correction e1fb941; no six-pair native verdict from that attempt.
Retained-image perf sampling completes all modules but fails 22 existing pointer-sign output assertions (#3674); used only for CPU attribution. Native timing uses normal image cleanup.
